thread:
Sam Ops: Kickoff — preparing a new dedicated GPU pilot in eu-central-1 + ap-southeast-1. Need quota increases and infra prep. (thread_ts=1896007890)

Alex M: ok. list exact quotas please so I can open provider cases and mark cost owner.

Sam Ops: TL;DR:
- Target reserve: 40 A100-equivalent nodes (22 eu-central-1 / 18 ap-southeast-1)
- Preferred instance families: p4d and a100 variants (note: provider naming varies; include "A100-equivalent" in the request)
- Spot fallback capacity: ~25 nodes
- ENI quota: bump to 8000 (we're close on current account)
- Elastic IPs: 200
- Subnet plan: expand worker subnets to /18 in two AZs per region to allow prefilled IPs for autoscaler
- Security group rules per account: increase to 250
- NAT Gateway throughput / concurrent conn: request uplift and +2 NAT gateways per region
- Transit Gateway attachments: increase to 10

Tasha (cloud_admin): I’ll compile account IDs and billing contact. prefer separate tickets per region. Who is cost approver?

Marta: finance ack. rough cost check: 40 p4d-style nodes reserved can be expensive; I’ll model 1yr convertible vs 3yr reserved + spot mix. Expect ~30% savings on 1yr conv, 50-60% if we include spot for burst.

Ria: For security, want an allowlist workflow before increasing SG rules  I’ll draft a lightweight approval flow and share to security. Also, need justification notes for provider (we’ll include expected RPS and latency SLOs).

Alex M: Draft support text I’m going to submit  will paste and tag for review.

Alex M: ```
Hello,

Account: <REDACTED>. Redwood Inference requests quota increases to support a dedicated inference pilot in eu-central-1 and ap-southeast-1. Details:

1) GPU instances: p4d/a100-equivalent quota -> 40 total (22 eu-central-1, 18 ap-southeast-1)
2) ENI per account -> 8000
3) Elastic IPs -> 200
4) Subnet CIDR expansions to /18 in two AZs per region to provide IP headroom for autoscaling
5) Security Group rules per account -> 250
6) NAT Gateway throughput and additional NAT gateway limit -> please advise uplift
7) Transit Gateway attachment limit -> 10

Purpose: production pilot for low-latency LLM inference with steady baseline + short bursts. Timeline: Q2 pilot; please expedite and escalate if needed.

Contacts: tasha_cloud@redwood.com; infra@redwood.com; marta@redwood.com

Thanks,
Redwood Inference  Infra
```

infra-bot: [automated] Support cases opened: CASE-998001 (eu gpu/eni/eip), CASE-998002 (apac gpu/eni/eip), CASE-998003 (networking/subnets). Status: pending.
